title: Incident: detection, communication and blameless postmortem

videos.script: Something is wrong, and this time it needs a person. {{wrong}} An incident is declared, not discovered. Someone says it out loud, and takes charge. {{declare}} Three jobs follow. One person decides. One person fixes. One person tells everyone else what is happening, every half hour, even when nothing is new. {{roles}} Restore first, understand later. A rollback needs no diagnosis. {{restore}} Afterwards comes the postmortem. It starts from a timeline built from the logs, not from memory. And it asks how the system allowed the mistake, never who made it. {{blameless}} You will rebuild the timeline of the payment incident, and find that the alert would never have fired. {{finding}}
